# Catch Foundation

> Ahmedabad-based environmental NGO dedicated to reforestation and green cover restoration through the Miyawaki technique and community engagement.

Catch Foundation is a registered NGO working across Gujarat and India to combat climate change through dense forest restoration, tree adoption programs, and environmental awareness initiatives. The organization partners with corporations, schools, and communities to implement sustainable environmental projects.

## Key Topics

- Miyawaki technique
- Tree plantation
- Environmental conservation
- Ahmedabad
- Gujarat

## Core Programs & Initiatives

- [About](https://catchfoundation.in/about): About Catch Foundation - environmental NGO mission and organizational information
- [Projects](https://catchfoundation.in/projects): Catch Foundation's tree plantation and reforestation projects across India
- [Adopt Now](https://catchfoundation.in/adopt-now): Tree adoption program to support Ahmedabad greening initiatives
- [Donate Now](https://catchfoundation.in/donations): Donation platform to support Catch Foundation's environmental conservation work
- [CSR Activities](https://catchfoundation.in/csr-activities): Corporate Social Responsibility programs and activities offered by Catch Foundation
- [School Activities](https://catchfoundation.in/school-activities): Environmental awareness and tree-planting programs for schools in Ahmedabad

## Miyawaki Forest Projects

- [Miyawaki Methodology](https://catchfoundation.in/method): Miyawaki technique methodology for dense forest restoration used by Catch Foundation
- [Gujarat Technical University - Ayurvedic Park](https://catchfoundation.in/projects/gujarat-technical-university): Miyawaki forest project at Gujarat Technical University in Ahmedabad
- [Sanand Project](https://catchfoundation.in/projects/sanand-cvsp): Miyawaki dense forest project in Sanand, Gujarat with Mitsubishi Electric
- [Raysan - 388](https://catchfoundation.in/projects/raysan-388): Miyawaki reforestation project at Raysan-388 in Gujarat
- [Raysan - 393](https://catchfoundation.in/projects/raysan-393): Miyawaki dense forest project at Raysan-393 in Gujarat

- [Eco-Warriors Team](https://catchfoundation.in/team): Catch Foundation team members and Eco-Warriors volunteer community

- [Awareness Activities](https://catchfoundation.in/awareness-activities): Community awareness campaigns and environmental events organized by Catch Foundation
- [Say No to Single-Use Plastic](https://catchfoundation.in/say-no-to-single-use-plastic-bag): Eco-friendly reusable bags initiative to reduce single-use plastic consumption
